content_sections.heading: MAMC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 1372 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MAMC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS with PG degree (MD/DNB) in Community Medicine from a recognized Medical College and must have a valid DMC registration number. Age limit: Maximum 45 years (at the time of interview) Other conditions: Must have a valid DMC registration number

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay scale: As per rules. Appointment on ad-hoc basis Tenure: 44 days or till regular post are filled, whichever is earlier Leaves as per rules

content_sections.heading: How Will MAMC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Receiving of application forms, registration and verification of certificates Interview Registration and verification of certificates from 9:30 AM to 11:00 AM in conference room (Room no. 348) Interview from 11:00 AM onwards in AEFI committee room (Room no. 356)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form filled in the format uploaded on the MAMC website Original certificates One set of self-attested photocopies supporting age, qualification, marks, attempt, degree, DMC registration, category, experience certificate (if any) Two passport size photographs No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer for candidates working in a government setup

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MAMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application form in the format uploaded on the MAMC website. Report to the venue on 27.11.2026 between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM for submission of form, registration and certificate verification. Bring original certificates, one set of self-attested photocopies and two passport size photographs. Candidates working in a government setup must produce a No Objection Certificate from their current employer.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for attending the interview
